blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce Continuous-Action World Models (CoAWM), a framework for learning cross-embodiment spatiotemporal dynamics priors that support robot action generation across embodiments and execution frequencies. At its core is a shared latent function space that captures the spatial and temporal structure of robot actions. We learn this space through two stages. First, function pretraining brings trajectories from different embodiments and sampling frequencies into a common representation, learning shared dynamics priors through action reconstruction and consistency across temporal sampling views. By accommodating heterogeneous robot trajectories, this stage broadens the range of data sources available for pretraining and facilitates scaling to larger and more diverse datasets. Second, we connect the pretrained function space to a world-model backbone, enabling observations, language instructions, and the current robot state to condition the prediction of a latent action function. A single decoder takes any query time and returns the corresponding end-effector action. By separating shared dynamics priors from task-conditioned action selection and temporal sampling, our approach provides a unified foundation for transferring robot experience across embodiments and control frequencies.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了连续行动世界模型,这是一个学习跨表现的动态学前述学的框架,支持机器人在各种表现和执行频率上产生行动。 其核心是一个共享的潜在函数空间,能捕捉机器人动作的空间和时间结构. 我们通过两个阶段学习这个空间. 首先,功能前培训将不同表现和取样频率的轨迹纳入共同的表述,通过行动重建以及时间抽样观点的一致性来学习共同的动态前奏。 这一阶段通过容纳不同的机器人轨道,扩大了可用于预训的数据来源范围,并便利了向更大和更多样化的数据集的扩展。 其次,我们把预先训练的功能空间与世界模型主干网连接起来,使观测,语言指令,以及目前的机器人状态能够对潜在动作功能的预测条件化. 单个解码器需要任何查询时间并返回相应的终端效应动作. 通过将共享的动态前兆与任务条件行动选择和时间抽样区分开来,我们的方法为将机器人经验跨出变相和控制频率提供了一个统一的基础。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Overview of continuous action-function learning and deployment. Training Stage A learns shared spatiotemporal priors from typed trajectories across embodiments and temporal sampling grids. Training Stage B connects observation-conditioned latent prediction to the learned function space using latent and physical reconstruction supervision. At inference, current multimodal observations and visual features condition latent prediction; the function decoder combines the predicted latent with physical query times and observed context to produce embodiment-specific control commands.
blocks.zh: 图1:持续行动职能学习和部署概览。 培训阶段 一个学习者分享了跨越浮雕和时间采样网格的打出轨迹的分流前传. 培训阶段 B利用潜在和物理重建监督,将观察条件下的潜在预测与学到的功能空间联系起来。 推论,目前的多模式观测和视觉特征条件为潜伏预测;函数解码器将所预测的潜伏时间与物理查询时间和所观测到的上下文结合起来,产生出能被浮出水面的特有控制命令.

blocks.en: Robots with different bodies can perform similar tasks, yet their experience is recorded through different action interfaces and control frequencies [ 24 , 13 , 3 ] . A reaching motion may be demonstrated by one manipulator and executed by another, with different command sequences governing a related physical behavior. This diversity raises a central question for robot world models: how can experience collected across embodiments be used to learn shared spatiotemporal dynamics priors that guide action generation? Answering this question would broaden the sources of experience available to a model, allowing robot learning to benefit from data beyond a single embodiment or collection setup.
blocks.zh: 拥有不同身体的机器人可以执行类似的任务,然而他们的经验是通过不同的动作界面和控制频率[24,13,3]来记录的. 到达运动可由一个操纵者演示,由另一个操纵者执行,不同的命令序列支配相关的物理行为. 这种多样性对机器人世界模型提出了一个中心问题:如何利用从各种表现中收集的经验来学习指导行动生成的共享瞬间动态? 回答这个问题将扩大一个模型可以利用的经验来源,使机器人学习能够从单一的化身或收集设置以外的数据中受益。

blocks.en: The challenge is not simply to combine more trajectories. Robot datasets differ in what their actions specify, how those actions are grounded in the robot’s state, and when commands are issued. The same sequence index can correspond to different physical times, while numerically similar commands can have different meanings across action interfaces. A common storage format alone does not resolve these differences. To learn from heterogeneous experience, a model needs a representation that captures reusable spatial and temporal structure while retaining the information required to interpret and execute an action on a particular robot. For a world model, this representation must also connect shared experience to action selection in the current scene and task.
blocks.zh: 挑战不仅仅是把更多的轨迹结合起来。 机器人数据集在动作中的具体内容,动作如何以机器人状态为基础,以及命令何时发布方面,各有不同. 相同的序列索引可以对应不同的物理时间,而数字上相似的命令可以有不同的含义跨越动作界面. 仅靠共同的存储格式并不能解决这些差异. 为了从不同的经验中吸取教训,一个模型需要一种能捕捉可重复使用的空间和时间结构的表示,同时保留解释和执行特定机器人行动所需的信息。 就世界模式而言,这种代表性还必须将分享的经验与当前场景和任务的行动选择联系起来。

blocks.en: Our key insight is to learn the evolution of an action as a function, rather than treating its sampled commands as the fundamental object of representation. A latent action function encodes how a motion unfolds in space and time; individual commands are obtained by querying that function (Fig. 2 ). This provides a common learning space for trajectories sampled at different frequencies. More importantly, it separates two complementary learning problems: acquiring dynamics priors from heterogeneous trajectories, and selecting an action using the current interaction context. The former can draw on a broader pool of robot experience, while the latter connects these priors to the observation-conditioned capabilities of a world model.
blocks.zh: 我们的关键洞察力是学习一种行动作为一种函数的演变,而不是把其抽样指令作为代表的基本目标来对待. 潜在动作函数编码了运动在空间和时间中如何展开;单个命令是通过查询该函数(图2 )而获得的. 这为在不同频率取样的轨迹提供了一个共同的学习空间. 更重要的是,它将两个互补的学习问题区分开来:从不同的轨迹中获取动态前缀,以及利用当前互动背景选择一个动作. 前者可以借鉴更广泛的机器人经验库,而后者将这些前科与世界模型的观察条件能力相连接.

blocks.en: We introduce Continuous-Action World Models (CoAWM) to realize this idea through two stages (Fig. 1 ). First, we pretrain a shared latent function space using trajectories from different embodiments and sampling frequencies. A function encoder and decoder learn spatiotemporal dynamics priors through action reconstruction and consistency across temporal sampling views. This pretraining stage expands the range of trajectory sources that can contribute to representation learning, providing a path toward larger and more diverse training datasets. Second, we connect the pretrained function space to a world-model backbone. Visual observations, language instructions, and the current robot state condition a prediction head that produces a latent action function, which a shared decoder converts into end-effector actions through time queries. CoAWM thus connects cross-embodiment prior learning with task-conditioned action generation, while allowing the execution frequency to be specified through the query times.
blocks.zh: 我们通过两个阶段(图1)推行连续行动世界模式,以实现这一想法。 首先,我们利用不同表现和取样频率的轨迹,预演一个共享的潜在功能空间。 一个函数编码器和解码器通过动作再生和时间采样观点的一致性来学习spatiental动态前传. 这一培训前阶段扩大了能够促进代表性学习的轨迹来源范围,提供了通往更大和更多样化的培训数据集的道路。 第二,我们把预先训练的功能空间与世界模范骨干连接起来。 视觉观察,语言指示,以及目前的机器人状态条件 一个产生潜在动作函数的预测头,一个共享的解码器通过时间查询转换为终端效应动作. 因此,CoAWM将前期学习与任务条件动作生成相连接,同时允许通过查询时间指定执行频率.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : An action interval and its sampling grid are different objects. Schematic of a continuous scalar position reference. The first two panels query the same function over the same physical duration with different grids. The third changes the duration: the geometric progression is preserved, but its velocity and acceleration change. A reusable function representation must retain physical timing while allowing the execution grid to vary.
blocks.zh: 图2:一个动作间隔及其取样网格是不同的对象. 连续平分位置参考的外观 前两个面板以不同的网格在相同的物理期间查询相同的功能. 第三种会改变持续时间:几何进取被保留,但其速度和加速变化. 可重复使用的函数表示必须保留实际时间,同时允许执行网格变化.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Continuous Action and Function Representations
blocks.zh: 2.1 连续行动和职能代表

blocks.en: Action representations determine how a policy organizes motion over time. ACT predicts action chunks [ 34 ] , Diffusion Policy generates action sequences through denoising [ 10 ] , and FAST compresses temporal structure into frequency-domain tokens [ 26 ] . Continuous action representations capture how motion evolves over time and allow actions to be queried at different execution times. Dynamical Movement Primitives encode motor behavior through attractor dynamics and learned forcing terms [ 16 ] , Probabilistic Movement Primitives model distributions over trajectories [ 25 ] , and ProDMPs connect these dynamic and probabilistic formulations [ 19 ] . These foundations establish motion trajectories as structured objects from which reusable action priors can be learned.
blocks.zh: 行动说明决定一项政策如何在一段时间内组织动议。 ACT预测动作块 [34],扩散 政策通过发音[10]产生动作序列,FAST将时间结构压缩为频率域符号[26]. 持续的行动表示可以捕捉运动如何随时间演变,并允许在不同执行时间询问行动. 动态运动 原始人通过吸引器动态 和学习的强制术语编码运动行为 [16],概率 Movement Primitives模型在轨迹上的分布[25],ProDMP将这些能动和概率的配体相接 [19]. 这些地基将运动轨迹确立为结构化对象,可以从中学习可再用动作前缀.

blocks.en: Recent visuomotor policies explore different function families and decoding mechanisms. FLASH represents trajectories with a Legendre basis and history-anchored flow [ 2 ] , while B-spline Policy uses control points and knots to parameterize actions [ 14 ] . Neural Implicit Action Fields learn modulated continuous-time action functions and supervise their temporal derivatives [ 20 ] . Periodic-activation implicit networks provide a general foundation for coordinate-queryable neural functions and their derivatives [ 27 ] . These efforts to represent actions motivate us to learn shared spatiotemporal dynamics priors through a continuous function representation.
blocks.zh: 近期的维乌莫特政策探索了不同的功能家庭和解码机制. FLASH代表有"传奇"基础和历史-焦虑流[2],而B-spline Policy则使用控制点和结来参数化动作[14]. 神经隐性行动场学习调制连续时间行动功能并监督其时间衍生出[20]. 周期活化所隐含的网络为可协调的神经功能及其衍生物提供一般基础[27]. 这些代表行动的努力激励我们通过持续的职能代表来了解共同的瞬间动态。

blocks.en: A latent function representation captures how motion evolves over time. A decoder takes this representation and a time query to produce the corresponding action. Querying the same representation at different times yields action sequences at different temporal resolutions. FunDiff combines function encoding, latent diffusion, and continuous decoding for physical-field generation [ 30 ] . Function-Space Diffusion for Motion Planning models trajectory distributions using temporally correlated noise and boundary-compatible operators [ 7 ] . CAT learns a fixed-size set of continuous trajectory latents over a physical-time window and uses frequency-aware positional encoding with a causal action decoder to accommodate different control rates [ 31 ] . These works establish important precedents for learning continuous representations and transferring between temporal resolutions. CoAWM focuses on learning shared spatiotemporal dynamics priors from heterogeneous robot trajectories and connecting the resulting function space to world-model-conditioned action generation.
blocks.zh: 潜伏的函数表示可以捕捉运动如何随时间演变. 一个解码器会接受这个表示和时间查询以产生相应的动作. 在不同时间查询相同的代表,得出不同时间分辨率的行动顺序。 FunDiff结合了函数编码,潜在扩散,以及物理场生成的连续解码[30]. 用于运动的函数空间扩散 利用时间相通的噪音和与边界相容的运营商进行轨迹分布的规划模型[7]. CAT在物理时段窗口上学习出一套固定大小的连续轨迹潜伏,并使用有因果动作解码器的频率感知位置编码来适应不同的控制速率[31]. 这些工作为学习持续表述和在时间分辨率之间转移创造了重要的先例。 COAWM侧重于从多样的机器人轨迹中学习共享的spatiotemporal动态前传,并连接由此产生的函数空间和世界模型条件动作生成.

blocks.en: 2.2 Cross-Embodiment Learning and Action Priors
blocks.zh: 2.2 交叉学习和行动历程

blocks.en: Cross-embodiment learning expands the experience available for robot policy training. Open X-Embodiment brings together robot datasets and studies cross-robot policies [ 24 ] . Octo develops generalist pretraining and adaptation to new observation and action spaces [ 13 ] , and π 0 \pi_{0} combines a vision-language model with flow-based action generation for general robot control [ 3 ] . These approaches make heterogeneous data a practical resource for learning behavior across tasks and robot systems. A central representation question is which structure can be shared while maintaining a meaningful connection to each robot’s executable actions.
blocks.zh: 交叉化的学习可以扩大机器人政策培训的经验。 Open X-Embodiment集成了机器人数据集并研究了交叉机器人政策[24]. Octo开发了通论预训并适应新的观测和行动空间[13],而"π0\pi_{0"将视觉语言模式与以流为主的行动生成结合,用于通用机器人控制[3]. 这些方法使不同数据成为跨任务和机器人系统学习行为的实用资源. 一个中心代表问题是,在与每个机器人的可执行行动保持有意义的联系的同时,可以共享哪个结构.

blocks.en: Latent-action learning addresses this question by separating reusable action knowledge from specific command spaces. LAPA learns latent actions from video before adapting them to robot control [ 32 ] , and UniVLA learns task-centric latent actions for embodiment transfer [ 5 ] . LAC-WM learns shared latent actions from visual transitions with auxiliary motion reconstruction for cross-embodiment world modeling, and reports benefits from increasing the diversity of pretraining embodiments [ 15 ] . These results motivate shared action priors for both control and prediction. CoAWM approaches this problem through action trajectories: a function autoencoder learns their spatial and temporal structure, and an observation-conditioned head connects the pretrained function space to a world-model backbone. Its pretraining interface is designed to accommodate trajectories from multiple embodiments and sampling frequencies, broadening the sources of data available for learning dynamics priors.
blocks.zh: Latent-Action学习通过将可重复使用的行动知识与特定的指令空间相分离来解决这一问题. LAPA从视频中学习了潜伏动作后再进行机器人控制[32],UniVLA学习了以任务为中心的潜伏动作来进行浮出水面转移[5]. LAC-WM学习了视觉过渡与辅助运动重建的潜伏行动,用于跨表现世界的模型制作,并且报告从增加培训前表现的多样性中受益[15]。 这些结果激励了共同的控制和预测行动。 CoAWM通过动作轨迹来解决这一问题:一个函数自编码器学习它们的空间和时间结构,一个有观测条件的头把预先训练的函数空间与一个世界模型主干线连接起来. 其预训接口旨在容纳多发性能和采样频率的轨迹,拓宽可供学习动力学前科的数据来源.

blocks.en: 2.3 World Models for Action Generation and Execution
blocks.zh: 2.3 世界行动产生和执行模式

blocks.en: World models connect experience to predictions that support action selection. V-JEPA 2 adapts self-supervised video representations for action-conditioned prediction and planning [ 1 ] . LAWM learns latent actions through future-frame modeling [ 28 ] , while Learning Latent Action World Models In The Wild investigates continuous-valued latent actions for prediction and controllable interaction [ 12 ] . villa-X combines latent-action modeling with visual and proprioceptive forward dynamics and robot-action prediction [ 9 ] . Alongside LAC-WM [ 15 ] , these approaches highlight the role of an action representation in linking predicted transitions to executable behavior.
blocks.zh: 世界模型将经验与支持动作选择的预测联系起来. V-JEPA 2改编自导自导自演的视频表现,用于行动有条件的预测和规划[1]. LAWM通过未来框架模型[28]来学习潜在行动,而Learning Latent Action World Models In The Wild 则调查持续价值的潜在行动,用于预测和可控制的互动[12]. 别墅-X结合了潜在动作模型与视觉和自发前向动态和机器人动作预测[9]. 除了LAC-WM [15]之外,这些方法还突出了行动代表的作用,将预测的过渡与可执行行为联系起来.

blocks.en: LaWAM conditions action generation on predicted latent visual subgoals and explicitly supports physical-time alignment and mixed-frequency training [ 8 ] . Its mixed-frequency setting retains native-rate action sequences with variable lengths and uses physical-time encoding to align them. AHA-WAM separates a slow video planner from a fast action executor through observation-guided context routing and horizon-adaptive offset training [ 6 ] . AW-0 extends world-action modeling with joint code, video, and action generation [ 22 ] . CoAWM learns a shared latent function space through cross-embodiment pretraining and connects it to world model and action generation. Given visual observations, language instructions, and the current robot state, the model predicts a latent function in this pretrained space. The decoder then takes time queries to produce executable actions. This design makes the pretrained dynamics priors directly available to action generation and allows a single predicted function to produce action sequences at different execution frequencies.
blocks.zh: LaWAM为预测的潜在视觉次级目标提供行动条件,并明确支持物理时间调整和混合频率培训[8]。 其混合频率设置保留了有可变长度的本能率动作序列,并使用物理时间编码来对齐. AHA-WAM通过观察引导上下文路由和地平线适应相抵训练,将慢视频规划器与快动作执行器分开[6]. AW-0通过联合代码,视频,和动作生成扩展了世界行动模型[22]. 通过交叉表现预训,协会学习了共同的潜在功能空间,并将其与世界模式和行动生成联系起来。 考虑到视觉观测,语言指令,以及目前的机器人状态,模型预测了在这个被预先训练的空间中的潜在功能. 然后解码器需要时间查询才能产生可执行动作. 这种设计使得预受训练的动态前缀直接提供给动作生成,并允许一个单一的预测函数在不同执行频率生成动作序列.

blocks.en: Execution introduces complementary questions about continuity, latency, and commitment. Real-Time Chunking overlaps prediction and execution through inference-time inpainting [ 4 ] , Legato learns native continuation for action-chunking flow policies [ 21 ] , and REMAC uses masked action chunking to address real-time execution [ 29 ] . Mixture of Horizons combines action predictions over multiple horizons [ 17 ] ; PACE uses kinematic phases to select execution boundaries [ 23 ] , and DVAC adapts the executed prefix using denoising variance [ 11 ] . Reliable Action-Chunk Extension models when to switch according to predicted subskill transitions [ 33 ] , whereas Reachability-aware Accelerated Chunk Execution retimes predicted state paths under physical constraints [ 18 ] . These methods concern how a plan is committed, continued, or retimed during execution. CoAWM complements these execution mechanisms by separating the latent action function, the times at which it is queried, and the physical timing of the represented motion.
blocks.zh: 执行工作提出了关于连续性、持久性和承诺的补充问题。 实时春金通过推论-时间插图来重复预测和执行 [4], Legato 学习本土续作动作春金流政策 [21],REMAC使用蒙面动作块处理实时执行[29]. 地平线的混合结合了多地平线上的动作预测[17];PACE使用动相来选择执行边界[23],而DVAC使用去诺能差异来调整被执行前缀[11]. 可靠的Action-Chunk扩展模型,当根据预测的子技能过渡进行切换时[33],而可达可达性-可知加速Chunk Entertained Chunk Entertainment retions在物理限制下预测的状态路径[18]. 这些方法涉及计划如何执行、继续或重新执行。 妇女权利委员会通过区分潜在的行动功能、询问时间和代为动议的实际时间来补充这些执行机制。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: Continuous-Action World Models (CoAWM) connect world model and action generation through a pretrained space of action functions. The central representation is a latent function that describes how an action evolves over physical time. A decoder takes this latent function and time queries to produce the corresponding actions, enabling action generation at different execution frequencies through queries at the corresponding time points.
blocks.zh: 连续行动世界模式通过预先训练的行动空间功能将世界模式和行动生成联系起来。 中央代表是一种潜在功能,它描述一种行动如何随着实际时间演变。 解码器取取了这个潜在的函数和时间查询来生成相应的动作,从而可以通过在相应时间点的查询在不同执行频率生成动作.

blocks.en: CoAWM uses two training stages. Stage A learns an action-function encoder and decoder from timestamped robot trajectories. A Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) encoder combines specialized processing of end-effector position, orientation, and gripper commands with joint attention across these action components. Training aligns representations of the same motion observed at different frequencies. This provides a shared function space for learning from trajectories collected across robot embodiments and at different frequencies, broadening the data available for pretraining. Stage B connects the learned function space to a world-model backbone. The prediction head combines VLM features, predicted future visual features, and robot proprioception, with current visual features contributing through an output residual. It predicts a function in the pretrained space. Expert trajectories supervise both its latent representation and the actions obtained by decoding it. At inference, the decoder queries the predicted latent function at time points determined by the desired execution frequency.
blocks.zh: 妇女问题委员会采用两个培训阶段。 A阶段从有时间戳的机器人轨迹中学习动作功能编码器和解码器. 一个转换器(Miture-of-Transfers (MoT))编码器结合了终端效应器位置,取向,和抓取器指令的专门处理,并在这些动作组件中共同关注. 培训对不同频率观察到的同一运动的表述进行了协调。 这提供了一个共享的功能空间,用于学习在机器人中以不同频率收集的轨迹,从而扩大可用于预训的数据。 B阶段将所学的函数空间与世界模范骨干连接. 预测头结合了VLM特征,预测了未来的视觉特征,以及机器人自控,而目前的视觉特征通过输出后遗症来贡献. 它预测了在被预训空间中的函数. 专家轨道监督其潜在代表性和通过解码获得的行动。 推断出,解码器会询问在所期望的执行频率决定的时间点上预测的潜在功能.

blocks.en: 3.2 Continuous Action Function Representation
blocks.zh: 3.2 连续行动职能

blocks.en: A function latent with a physical-time interface. Mixture-of-Transformers for Action Function Encoding. The MoT encoder brings position (XYZ), orientation (Q), and gripper (G) components into a shared latent function representation. In the dual-arm implementation, these streams contain six position coordinates, eight quaternion coordinates, and two gripper commands. Each stream combines the corresponding components of both arms. Input tokens incorporate timestamps and validity masks, so the encoder can process different temporal views without treating missing observations as valid commands.
blocks.zh: 动作函数编码转换器。 MOT编码器将位置(XYZ),取向(Q),和抓取器(G)等组件引入了共享的潜在函数代表. 在双臂执行中,这些流包含6个位置坐标,8之四坐标和2个抓取命令. 每道溪流结合了两臂的相应成分. 输入符中包含时间戳和有效性口罩,因此编码器可以处理不同的时间视图而无需将缺失的观察视为有效的命令.

blocks.en: The encoder first aggregates trajectory tokens into learned latent queries through typed Perceiver blocks. Latent MoT blocks then exchange information across the three action-component streams. Each stream has its own query, key, value, and output projections, normalization layers, and feed-forward networks. Attention is computed jointly over all streams, allowing the specialized Transformer parameters to model each action component while shared attention captures their temporal coordination. The bottleneck contains 96 tokens of width 256, with 32 tokens allocated to each modality.
blocks.zh: 编码器首先通过打入的 Perceiver 块将轨迹符号聚合成学到的潜在查询。 然后Latet MOT块在三个动作组件流之间交换信息。 每个流都有自己的查询,键,值,和输出预测,常态层,和向导网络. 在所有流中共同计算注意,使专门的变形器参数能够模拟每个行动部分,同时共同注意抓住它们的时间协调。 瓶颈有96个道具,宽度为256个,其中32个道具分配给了每种道具.

blocks.en: Independent time queries. The decoder forms a query from the requested physical time, its Fourier features, a modality embedding, and known execution information. Typed cross-attention blocks read the latent memory and produce XYZ, Q, and G outputs. Each requested timestamp is evaluated through its own query-to-memory attention. Consequently, an action at a given timestamp does not depend on the number or ordering of the other requested timestamps. A single latent can therefore produce actions at different execution frequencies through the corresponding time queries.
blocks.zh: 独立时间查询. 解码器从请求的物理时间、其Fourier特性、一种嵌入方式以及已知的执行信息中形成查询。 所打入的交叉切入块读取了潜在的内存并生成了XYZ,Q,和G输出. 每个要求的时间戳通过自己的查询到记忆的注意力来评价. 因此,在特定时间戳上的行动并不取决于要求的其他时间戳的数目或顺序。 因此,单一的潜伏通过相应的时间查询可以在不同的执行频率产生动作.

The hard anchor applies to position and orientation. Gripper commands use a separate time-indexed knot readout: the decoder predicts gripper values at native knots, and a query selects the nearest knot. This accommodates discrete gripper changes alongside time-queryable pose commands.

blocks.en: 3.3 Learning Cross-Embodiment Dynamics Priors
blocks.zh: 3.3 学习跨源动态

blocks.en: Stage A learns reusable dynamics priors from action trajectories. Its inputs are timestamped actions and known execution information, allowing action data to contribute to pretraining without paired language instructions or camera observations. The MoT encoder integrates XYZ/Q/G streams through specialized Transformer parameters and shared attention. This common action organization, together with validity masks and execution context, provides the representational interface for incorporating trajectories from different embodiments.
blocks.zh: A阶段从动作轨迹中学习可再使用的动态前缀. 它的投入是时间标注的动作和已知的执行信息,使得动作数据能够在没有配对语言指令或相机观察的情况下帮助预训. MoT编码器通过专门的变形器参数来整合XYZ/Q/G流并共享关注. 这个共同行动组织,加上有效性口罩和执行背景,为吸收不同表现的轨迹提供了代表界面.

blocks.en: A scalable trajectory interface. Separating action-function pretraining from task-specific observation-to-action learning makes trajectory data usable through a common representation. Additional sources enter through timestamped end-effector trajectories, component validity, and known execution information. Shared attention in the MoT encoder captures coordination among action components, while the explicit context preserves information needed to interpret the motion for a particular robot. This is the mechanism through which CoAWM connects cross-embodiment data collection to the scaling of dynamics-prior learning.
blocks.zh: 可缩放的轨迹接口 。 将行动功能前培训与特定任务的观察与行动学习分开,使轨迹数据能够通过共同的表述加以利用。 其他来源通过时间标记的终端效应轨迹、组件有效性和已知的执行信息输入。 在MOT编码器中共同关注捕捉动作组件之间的协调,而清晰的上下文保存了解释特定机器人运动所需的信息. 这是一种机制,通过这一机制,COAWM将跨表现数据收集与扩大动态优先学习联系起来。

blocks.en: Latent alignment connects the prediction to the pretrained function representation, while action supervision ties it to the commands produced at native target times. The function encoder and decoder remain frozen. Gradients through the decoder train the latent prediction pathway and backbone adapters, preserving the function space while adapting its use to the task. blocks.en: 3.5 Time-Query Action Execution

blocks.en: The inference path consists of observation encoding, visual world prediction, latent-function prediction, and time-query decoding. The expert trajectory and function encoder are used only for training. This organization connects pretrained dynamics priors to task-aware action generation and frequency-specific execution through a shared function interface.
blocks.zh: 推论路径由观测编码,视觉世界预测,潜伏函数预测,以及时间清滑解码等组成. 专家轨道和功能编码器仅用于培训。 这个组织通过共享函数接口,将预先训练的动态前传与任务意识动作生成和频率特定执行相连接.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: We evaluate continuous action functions from four perspectives: representation accuracy, closed-loop execution, cross-frequency querying, and action quality. We first examine whether the function space can accurately represent robot actions, then evaluate task performance after alignment with LaWAM, focusing on the effect of the continuous representation on the smoothness of initial execution. (These experiments provide a rapid validation of the method; a subsequent arXiv version will expand the training scale and perform full fine-tuning.)
blocks.zh: 我们从四个角度评价连续行动功能:表现准确性、闭路执行、跨频率查询和行动质量。 我们首先检查功能空间是否能够准确地代表机器人动作,然后在与LaWAM对接后评价任务性能,侧重于持续表示对初始执行平滑性的影响. (这些实验对方法提供了快速验证;之后的arXiv版本将扩大训练规模并进行全面的微调.

blocks.en: 4.1 Representation Accuracy of Continuous Actions
blocks.zh: 4.1 持续行动的准确性

blocks.en: A continuous function representation preserves action details while providing a unified query interface for different time points. On 8,192 held-out evaluation windows, the function autoencoder achieves a position reconstruction error of 2.503 mm and a rotation error of 0.2295 ∘ 0.2295^{\circ} . This result shows that the function space can represent the original action trajectories with high accuracy, providing a representation foundation for subsequent world-model alignment (Fig. 3 ).
blocks.zh: 一个连续的函数表示保留了动作细节,同时为不同的时点提供一个统一的查询界面. 在8,192个被搁置的评价窗口上,功能自编码器实现了2.503毫米的位置重建错误和0.2295 ∘ 0.2295 ^{\ Circ}. 这一结果显示,函数空间可以高精度地代表原始的动作轨迹,为后来的世界模型对接(图3.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Mean position and rotation reconstruction errors of the function autoencoder on 8,192 held-out evaluation windows used for model selection.
blocks.zh: 图3:用于模型选择的8 192个挂起评价窗口上的函数自动编码器的平均位置和旋转重建错误。

blocks.en: 4.2 Smoother Initial Execution at Similar Movement Speeds
blocks.zh: 4.2 类似移动速度的平滑初始执行

blocks.en: Continuous action functions significantly reduce abrupt changes in motion during initial execution. Across 16 tasks and 800 pairs of matched initial conditions, we measure motion metrics over the first second of each execution. Compared with LaWAM, position jerk RMS decreases from 150.87 to 95.46, a reduction of 36.7%; rotation jerk RMS decreases from 746.06 to 341.73, a reduction of 54.2%. The velocity RMS values of the two methods are 0.338 and 0.332, respectively, showing that continuous action functions reduce abrupt changes in motion without reducing action execution speed (Fig. 4 ).
blocks.zh: 连续的动作功能会大大减少初始执行期间运动的突然变化. 在16项任务和800对匹配的初始条件中,我们测量每项执行的第一秒的运动度量。 与LAWAM相比,职位混蛋RMS从150.87降至95.46,减少了36.7%;旋转混蛋RMS从746.06降至341.73,减少了54.2%。 这两个方法的速度RMS值分别为0.338和0.332,表明连续的动作函数会减少运动的突然变化而不会降低动作执行速度(图4).

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Initial execution quality during the first 1 s across 800 paired trials in 16 tasks. The highlighted percentages show the reduction in translation jerk RMS, the reduction in rotation jerk RMS, and the retained translation speed RMS relative to LaWAM, respectively. Metrics describe actual end-effector motion, with equal task weighting and both arms pooled.
blocks.zh: 图4:前1阶段初步执行质量,在16个任务中的800个对接审判中。 突出的百分比表明,相对LaWAM而言,翻译机型RMS减少,旋转机型RMS减少,保留了翻译速度RMS。 量子描述的是实际的末端效应运动,任务权重相等并兼有武器集合.

blocks.en: This result demonstrates the improvement in initial execution quality provided by continuous action representations. In the same evaluation, our method achieves a task success rate of 75.1%. However, we find that substantial jerk tails remain over longer execution windows, and plan to further address action stability during sustained execution and replanning in subsequent optimization.
blocks.zh: 这一结果表明,通过持续的行动陈述,初步执行质量有所提高。 在同一评估中,我们的方法实现了75.1%的任务成功率。 然而,我们发现,大量混蛋尾巴仍然停留在较长的执行窗口上,并计划在持续执行期间进一步解决行动稳定性问题,并在随后的优化中重新规划。

blocks.en: 4.3 Multitask Manipulation and Cross-Frequency Execution
blocks.zh: 4.3 多任务管理和跨频率执行

blocks.en: The aligned function policy can perform a variety of bimanual manipulation tasks. In evaluations with 50 trials per task, it achieves a success rate of 94% on the two-bottle task, 90% on both left and right A2B tasks, 88% on the burger task, and 86% on the hammer task. In a separate preliminary evaluation covering 50 tasks with three trials per task, both methods complete all three trials on 30 tasks.
blocks.zh: 相配合的函数政策可以执行多种双人操纵任务. 在每项任务进行50个试验的评价中,它取得了94%的双瓶任务成功率,90%的左右A2B任务成功率,88%的汉堡任务成功率,86%的锤子任务成功率. 在一项涉及50项任务和每项任务3项审判的单独初步评价中,两种方法都完成了30项任务的所有三项审判。

blocks.en: By changing the time query points, the same function policy can output actions at 10, 15, 20, 30, 50, and 60 Hz while keeping the execution segment and replanning period fixed at 1.2 s. The corresponding numbers of successes are 116, 121, 117, 119, 116, and 110, with 150 trials evaluated at each frequency. These results demonstrate cross-frequency execution within a fixed physical-time window (Fig. 5 ).
blocks.zh: 通过改变时间查询点,同样的函数政策可以输出动作为10,15,20,30,50和60 Hz,同时将执行段和再规划期固定为1.2 s. 相应的成功案例有116起,121起,117起,119起,116起,110起,每起频率评价150起. 这些结果显示,在一个固定的物理时间窗口内进行跨频率执行(图5)。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : (a) CoAWM success rates at six execution frequencies, evaluated with 150 trials per frequency across 50 tasks (three trials per task), with the execution segment and replanning period fixed at 1.2 s. (b) Five selected tasks from a separate 16-task evaluation with 50 trials per task. The panels therefore use different evaluation cohorts and denominators.
blocks.zh: 图5:(a) 联阿特派团在6个执行频率上的成功率,在50个任务上以每频率150次审判(每任务3次审判)进行评价,执行部分和重新规划期定为1.2 s. (b) 从单独的16个任务评价中选定5个任务,每项任务50次。 因此,各小组使用不同的评价组群和分母。

blocks.en: 4.4 Reducing Execution Energy Consumption
blocks.zh: 4.4 减少能源消耗

blocks.en: We further use positive mechanical work based on PD torque estimates to measure energy consumption during execution. Among 16 prespecified scenarios, on the 13 scenarios in which both methods succeed, the function policy reduces the mean estimated positive mechanical work from 506.66 to 392.13, a reduction of 22.6%, with lower values in 12 scenarios (Fig. 6 ).
blocks.zh: 我们进一步利用基于PD扭矩估计的正力机械工作来衡量执行过程中的能耗. 在16个预先确定的情况中,在两种方法都成功的13个情况中,功能政策将平均估计的正机械工作从506.66减少到392.13,减少了22.6%,12个情况中的数值较低(图6)。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Estimated positive mechanical work for the 13 jointly successful scenes among 16 prespecified scenes, computed from PD torque estimates and measured joint velocities. Open blue points denote LaWAM and filled red points denote CoAWM; connecting segments identify paired scenes. The two time columns report physical execution duration in seconds using the same method colors.
blocks.zh: 图6:从PD扭矩估计和测量联合速度计算出来的16个预先指定的场景中13个联合成功场景的机械工程估计值。 开开的蓝色点表示LaWAM,填充的红色点表示CoAWM;连接段表示成对的场景. 两个时间栏使用相同的方法颜色报告实际执行时间数秒.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: Continuous function representations separate the learning of action structure from the choice of execution frequency. The model learns how actions evolve over physical time, while the execution side obtains commands at the required frequency through time queries. Execution frequency can therefore be adjusted while keeping the action-segment duration and replanning period unchanged, allowing the same action representation to serve different execution clocks.
blocks.zh: 连续函数表示将动作结构的学习与执行频率的选择相分离. 该模型学习动作如何随着物理时间演变,而执行方则通过时间查询以所需的频率获得命令. 因此,可以调整执行频率,同时保持行动部分的持续时间和重新规划期不变,允许同样的行动表述服务于不同的执行时钟.

blocks.en: This representation also makes action quality an important evaluation dimension alongside task success rate. The current experiments demonstrate high trajectory reconstruction accuracy and smoother initial execution at similar movement speeds. At the same time, offline reconstruction quality, closed-loop task success rate, and stability during sustained execution have different optimization requirements. Considering these metrics together enables a more complete evaluation of the practical effects of aligning function representations with a world model.
blocks.zh: 这种代表性还使行动质量与任务成功率一起成为一个重要的评价方面。 目前实验显示轨迹重建精度高,在相近的运动速度下初步执行更平滑. 同时,离线重建质量,闭机任务成功率,持续执行期间的稳定性都有不同的优化要求. 综合考虑这些衡量标准,可以更全面地评价使职能表述与世界模式相一致的实际效果。

blocks.en: The shared function space provides a unified interface for expanding the training scale. During function pretraining, we will introduce action trajectories from more embodiments and collection frequencies; during world-model alignment, we will further perform full fine-tuning, using visual predictions and task information to learn task-related action functions. Subsequent experiments will examine how larger-scale data and training affect task performance, cross-embodiment transfer, and stability during sustained execution.
blocks.zh: 共享功能空间为扩大培训规模提供了统一的接口. 在功能预训期间,我们将从更多的表现和收集频率引入动作轨迹;在世界模式调整期间,我们将进一步进行全面的微调,利用视觉预测和任务信息来学习与任务相关的行动功能. 随后的实验将审查更大的数据和培训如何影响任务执行、交叉表现转移和持续执行期间的稳定。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We present CoAWM, which connects action representation learning, world-model prediction, and time-query execution through a shared function space. Two-stage training uses the spatiotemporal structure in trajectories for task-related action generation and supports different execution frequencies through time queries. Preliminary experiments demonstrate the reconstruction accuracy, bimanual task execution capabilities, and improvements in initial action quality of this representation, providing a foundation for further expanding the scale of data and training.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍CoAWM,它通过一个共享的函数空间,将动作表现学习,世界模型预测和时序执行联系起来. 两阶段训练在与任务相干动作生成的轨迹中使用了spatiotepal结构,并通过时间查询支持不同的执行频率. 初步实验显示了重建的准确性,双人任务执行能力,以及这种代表的初步行动质量的提高,为进一步扩大数据规模和培训奠定了基础.
